      About this item

      • 100+ GAME AUDIO PRESETS — Unlock tailored audio presets for top games like GTA V, FIFA, Call of Duty, and more, with the Arctis Nova 5 Companion App
      • 60-HOUR BATTERY — Play longer than ever with the next-gen battery. Go 8 hours a day all week; plus with USB-C Fast Charge get 6 hours of use in just 15 minutes
      • QUICK-SWITCH WIRELESS — Toggle between 2.4GHz gaming and Bluetooth 5.3 with a tap of a button to take a call or listen to media; notification beeps keep you posted on incoming calls while gaming
      • HIGH-FIDELITY AUDIO — Forged from a rare-earth metal, the custom-designed Neodymium Magnetic Drivers create an ultra-detailed soundscape of clear highs, pinpoint mids, and deep bass
      • NEXT-GEN MIC — Our upgraded, fully retractable ClearCast 2.X microphone has 2X the clarity with a high-bandwidth chipset supporting 32KHz/16Bit audio

      Previous page

      1. 100+ PS5 Audio Presets at Your Fingertips

        Get the best audio EQ presets without a PC, in real-time - no need to leave your game.

      2. Hear What Others Don't

        Enhance footsteps, bomb plants & potion drinking for a powerful audio advantage with custom presets.

      3. Two Save Slots

        Keep separate EQ profiles for gaming and Bluetooth audio, which are saved and switch automatically.

      4. Co-developed with Pros

        We consulted the best - Rain, James Baldwin, and Faker - to create the biggest advantage for you.

      Next page
      Previous page

      1. Quick-Switch Wireless

        Switch from gaming-grade 2.4GHz wireless to Bluetooth in a flash; take a call or listen to audio.

      2. Rise Above Console Wars

        The compact USB-C dongle takes you to your preferred platform: PlayStation, PC, Switch, or mobile.

      3. Shortcuts at Your Fingertips

        Toggle Quick-Switch Wireless, start the sesh with the Power button, mute and adjust volume whenever.

      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

        5.0 out of 5 stars Excellent Wireless Headset for PlayStation and Beyond!
        Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 27 October 2025
        Style Name: Nova WhiteVerified Purchase
        The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5P Wireless is easily one of the best gaming headsets.The build quality feels solid yet lightweight, and the white design matches perfectly with the PS5 aesthetic. Comfort-wise, it’s superb — the ear cushions are soft, and I can wear them for hours without any discomfort.

        The sound quality is outstanding, with rich, detailed audio and deep bass. The neodymium magnetic drivers deliver clear directional sound, making games more immersive. I especially appreciate the 100+ audio presets via the app, which let you fine-tune the sound for different games or personal preference.

        Connectivity is quick and reliable whether using 2.4GHz wireless or Bluetooth, and the ability to switch between devices is very convenient. The Gen 2.X mic performs brilliantly, delivering crisp and clear voice chat without background noise — ideal for multiplayer sessions.

        Battery life is another big plus — up to 60 hours on a single charge is incredible. It easily lasts several days of regular gaming before needing a top-up.

        Overall, this headset offers premium performance, versatility, and comfort. Perfect for PS5, but also works seamlessly with PS4, PC, and mobile. Highly recommended for anyone wanting top-tier wireless sound without compromise!

      • M. D. Harris
        4.0 out of 5 stars Great headset with minor irritations
        Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 15 August 2025
        Style Name: Nova BlackVerified Purchase
        These arrive well packaged and immediately feel premium quality – certainly a step up from my previous Sony Pulse headset – these are also far more adjustable for fit (the Pulse had none). Set-up up with a PS5 can simply be plug-in the wireless dongle and play, but to get the best from them use the mobile app for customised profiles – these made a big difference in CoD. Audio quality is great (better than the Pulse) and the mic works well to. Battery life is excellent.

        My negatives are mostly minor, and not entirely Arctis's fault. I'm not a fan of the slide out mic, are these really needed these days? The Pulse worked fine without one. Volume control seems to go from too quiet to too loud in an instant and it's all in the last 10% of the volume control movement. Finally, and this is mostly down to Sony gatekeeping it seems, I have to keep insert the USB dongle whenever I want to use the headset (also the headset can only connect wirelessly to the PS5, not via Bluetooth) – I didn't have to do this with the Pulse headset – leaving the dongle in and just switching the headset on/off was all you needed to do to switch between headset/tv speakers.

        Overall a very good headset with some minor irritations.

      • JoeyJoe
        5.0 out of 5 stars Outstanding sound, long battery life – a great all-round wireless headset
        Reviewed in Australia on 1 June 2025
        Style Name: Nova WhiteVerified Purchase
        The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5P really delivers. The sound quality is excellent across games, music, and calls, with plenty of depth and clarity. The mic is surprisingly good too — especially when positioned close to your mouth. Communication comes through clearly and without distortion, which is great for online gaming or meetings.

        One of the standout features is the custom EQ presets, which are super handy if you’re not confident tweaking settings yourself. There’s a preset for just about everything, and they make a noticeable difference depending on what you're using the headset for.

        The dual wireless modes (Bluetooth and 2.4GHz) are solid, though it’s worth noting you can’t mix them — so you can’t, for example, listen to your phone’s audio while playing on console or PC. It’s not a dealbreaker, but something to be aware of if you were hoping for multitasking.

        Battery life is excellent. The comfort is also top-tier — light on the head, good ear padding, and no fatigue after long sessions.

        Only minor downside is the white version shows marks and wear a little more than darker colours — but it still looks great in a clean gaming setup.

        Overall, a great headset that balances performance, comfort, and battery life really well. Highly recommend.

        5.0 out of 5 stars Aradığım Kulaklığı Buldum!
        Reviewed in Turkey on 4 September 2025
        Style Name: Nova BlackVerified Purchase
        Razer Kraken V4 de yaşadığım sorunlar yüzünden iade etmiştim sonrasında bu ürünü satın aldım.

        Malzeme Kalitesi: Çok iyi. Plastik oldukça kaliteli bir yapıya sahip. Kırılacağını sanmıyorum.
        Buton ve tekerleklerin kalitesi yeterli. Kulak padleri iyi. Kafa bandı da kullanışlı. Kulağımda yük oluşturmuyor oldukça hafif ve kayma yapmıyor. Kulaklığı ilk elime aldığımda çok korktum çok küçük bu falan dedim ama kullanınca şaşırttı beni.
        Ses Kalitesi: SteelSeries GG yazılımı çok detaylı. Engine üzerinden ses limit ayarını kaldırınca tüm odalardan duyulacak kadar mini bir hoparlöre dönüşüyor son seste kulağıma takamadım resmen :) Hatta ek olarak eq ile de yükseltebiliyorsun sesi ama onu yaparsan 2+1 hoparlöre dönüşür gerek yok. İnanılmaz güçlü ve yüksek ses veriyor. Basslar temiz ve tok. Tizler yerinde. Bir sürü ekolayzır ayarı denedim en sevdiğim deep bass ayarı oldu.
        Mikrofon kalitesi: Buraya ses atabilseydim göstermek isterdim. Çok temiz, Kraken v4 razeletinden sonra profesyonel bir mikrofonla konuşuyormuşum gibi hissettiriyor. Discord üzerinden arkadaşlara da sordum sesimin çok iyi ve net geldiğini söylediler. Çok memnun kaldım.

        Özetle tüm testleri 2.4 modunda test ettim. Hem telefon hem de pc de testler gerçekleştirdim. En büyük avantajı da mobilde uygulaması desteği de var. Hunt Showdown oyununda test ettim ayak sesleri net ve hedefin yerini net tespit edebiliyorsun. CS2 de de gayet yeterliydi. Silah sesleri çok yüksek geliyor onu da bir kaç ayarla çözebiliyoruz. Tavsiye ederim.

        Kutudan çıktığında sarjı %68 idi. 6-7 saat kullanımdan sonra %56 ya düştü. 30 dk sarja taktım %94 e kadar doldu. Sarj tüketimi ve sarj hızı oldukça iyi.

        Tavsiye ederim. Oldukça memnun kaldım. Amazon' a hızlı kargo ve sorunsuz teslimat için teşekkür ediyorum.
